description: This Java class 'HashedCredentialHandler' implements the 'CredentialHandler' interface, providing methods to handle user credential matching and mutation using hashing and login services within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: HashedCredentialHandler
classes.description: A credential handler that verifies and hashes credentials using OFBiz's login services and cryptographic utilities.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the input credentials match the stored credentials using the login service.

methods.name: mutate
methods.description: Hashes the input credentials using the configured hash type.
